mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ad_message ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM ad_message WHERE enabled = true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_message (title, content, buttons, button_layout, button_config, enabled, delay_seconds, max_per_minute, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{buttons}, #{buttonLayout}, #{buttonConfig}, #{enabled}, #{delaySeconds}, #{maxPerMinute}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_message SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, buttons = #{buttons}, button_layout = #{buttonLayout}, button_config = #{buttonConfig}, enabled = #{enabled}, delay_seconds = #{delaySeconds}, max_per_minute = #{maxPerMinute}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ad_message WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY id DESC
